subject: Follow-up: pricing & commitment options for Streamly
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Singh <aditi@streamly.io>, Tom Alvarez <tom@streamly.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: pricing & commitment options for Streamly

Hi Aditi / Tom 

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and the two paths we discussed so you have everything in one place:

Summary of needs
- Workload: chat + summary generation across support and product workflows
- Expected volume: ~5-10M tokens/month initially, with spike loads to ~15M in month-on-month growth
- Latency SLO: 300-500ms p95 for interactive paths
- Data controls: need SOC2 evidence and standard DPA (we covered Private/Dedicated options briefly)

Pricing / unit economics (examples we discussed)
- List price: $100 / 1M tokens (example list for the model class discussed)
- Target: you mentioned a target of ~$50 / 1M tokens to meet your unit economics

Discount paths we can pursue
1) Startup program (fast eligibility-based discount) — typically a 30-40% credit for eligible startups for the first 6 months, fast approval, minimal procurement friction. See attached Redwood-Startup-Program-T&C.pdf.
2) Committed-use (12 or 24 months) — predictable unit price in exchange for volume commit; we can tier discounts by commit size (examples below).
3) Multi-year incentives — for 24+ month commitments we can layer additional price protection / deeper discounting and include SLA commitments.

Quick proposal (ballpark) — I’ll confirm exact numbers with finance but to give you a sense:
- 12-month commit at 10M tokens/mo (120M tokens total): list $100 -> proposed effective $35-40 / 1M tokens (~60-65% off list) depending on payment terms
- 12-month commit at 5M tokens/mo (60M total): effective $50-60 / 1M tokens (~40-50% off list)
- Startup program (if eligible): 6 months at ~40% off + credits for onboarding

Next steps
- Aditi: confirm which option you want us to price formally (startup path vs committed-use) and confirm target budget range ($/month or $/1M tokens).
- Ben: will get legal/finance a first-pass committed-use term sheet and startup T&C, attach both here.
- Marissa: can jump on for a more formal commercial call once Aditi confirms preferred path.

Attachments: Redwood-Startup-Program-T&C.pdf, Committed-Use-SLA-Proposal.pdf

Thanks — enjoyed the convo, we’ll move quickly on pricing once you confirm which path you prefer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Aditi Singh <aditi@streamly.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@streamly.io>
Date: 2027-03-22T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & commitment options for Streamly

Thanks Ben — helpful recap. A few clarifying points so we can decide which path to pursue formally: 

1) Volumes — we expect to start at ~5M tokens/month and scale to 10-15M within 6 months. The 120M annual commit would be fine if the price works for us.
2) Budget — our current budget target for inference is $2k- $6k/month (this is what we can flex during the pilot); if we go committed-use we can expand. Our target unit economics is ~$50 / 1M tokens or lower to make the product margin work.
3) Startup program — we are seed-stage with $3M raised (VC-backed) — qualify for the startup program? If so, the faster the better. Please let me know what proof you need.

Can you confirm the concrete $/1M figures for the two options (startup credit vs 12-month commit at 60M and 120M) and any payment terms (monthly invoice vs upfront)? Also want to make sure SOC2 artifacts and DPA terms are available before we sign.

If you can send a short commercial term sheet we can review with Finance and Legal this week.

Thanks,
Aditi
Co-founder & Head of ML | Streamly
aditi@streamly.io

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Singh <aditi@streamly.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & commitment options for Streamly

Aditi — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming volume and funding status. We can move fast on both paths; below are concrete, conservative figures I ran by Finance this morning. Final numbers will be on the formal term sheet/DocuSign but this should let you model economics.

Option A: Startup program (fast)
- Eligibility: Seed-stage, VC-backed ($3M) — qualifies.
- Offer: 40% off list price for first 6 months + $5k credit for onboarding (applied to invoices).
- Pricing example (applies to list $100 / 1M baseline): effective ~$60 / 1M tokens for months 1-6 (factoring in credit) depending on your onboarding usage pattern.
- Payment terms: monthly invoice, standard net 30.
- Docs needed: basic company info, funding snapshot (Cap table or investor intro), and signed startup T&C (attached).

Option B: Committed-use (12 months)
- Tier 1: 60M total (5M/mo) — effective $55 / 1M tokens (approx 45% off list); monthly billing with quarterly true-up.
- Tier 2: 120M total (10M/mo) — effective $35 / 1M tokens (approx 65% off list) with upfront or net-30 quarterly payment options; includes 1% additional discount for annual prepay.
- SLA: standard uptime SLA + optional latency credits available in the attached Committed-Use-SLA-Proposal.pdf.

Option C: Multi-year (24 months)
- For committed 24-months at 10M/mo we can lock price at $32 / 1M tokens and include a 2-year price cap and extended support SLA.

Notes / next steps
- SOC2 / DPA: Marissa/Rishi — please attach SOC2 and DPA links to this thread so Aditi can review.
- Aditi: if you want the fastest path, startup program will get you immediate credits and lower friction — we can flip to a committed-use discount later with a contract amendment. If you want long-term unit economics guaranteed, we should go committed-use (120M / 12mo looks like the cutover point to get near your $50 / 1M target).
- I’ll open a HubSpot quote for both the startup path and the 120M committed-use so you have a side-by-side commercial view. Link to deal is below.

Attachments: Redwood-Startup-Program-T&C.pdf, Committed-Use-SLA-Proposal.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9823
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/streamly/committed-use-proposal

If that looks reasonable, I’ll ask Legal/Finance to draft a short term sheet and route for signature. Want me to prepare both a startup agreement and a committed-use quote?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-24T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Streamly — discount approval request

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding the thread with Streamly. They qualify for the startup program (seed, $3M) but are also open to a 12-month commit at 120M tokens which gets them to ~$35 / 1M. Aditi said budget is $2k- $6k/mo during pilot, will expand if we do committed-use.

Ask: can we approve a 40% startup credit (standard program docs attached) to get them on quickly, and simultaneously prepare a 12mo 120M quote to lock them in at the ~$35 / 1M level if they choose? If legal needs to tweak the startup T&C I can route.
